items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Each guard is a small `if not ...is_cached(rel_obj):` block with a clear comment, "Don't overwrite a value cached by a nested prefetch." It keeps the existing names and indentation.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Uses the existing field-cache API (`is_cached`) and adds no new bookkeeping. The same guard appears in three prefetch paths. That is consistent with the surrounding code, not systemic copy-paste. No debug leftovers, and the temporary test was removed.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: This is a minimal conditional guard. No exceptions are swallowed and there are no magic constants. If nothing is cached, behaviour is unchanged. 927 tests in the related suites pass, and hidden tests pass (F2P 1/1, P2P 85/85).

items.name: Guard is conditional and covers the one-to-one variant
items.name_zh: 仅在已缓存时跳过回填，并考虑一对一情形
items.evidence: Guards `self.field.is_cached(rel_obj)` in the reverse-FK manager and `self.related.field.is_cached(rel_obj)` in `ReverseOneToOneDescriptor`, covering the one-to-one case from the issue. The assignment still happens when nothing is cached. Verified with o2o and FK tests that failed before the fix and passed after.
